name: @asobacloud/sdlc-integrity-mcp

tools.name: AuditCodeIntegrity
tools.description: Run the code integrity auditor (lifecycle teardown parity, mock-theater test detection, naming invariants, swallowed exceptions) against a file or directory. Returns structured JSON findings.

target.description: File or directory to audit (default: cwd)

tools.name: JsSafetyChecker
tools.description: Run the JavaScript safety checker (AST-based duplicate function, duplicate HTML ID, syntax errors) against a file or directory. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

tools.name: PythonSafetyChecker
tools.description: Run the Python safety checker (bandit security issues, ruff style/lint issues, AST mutable default arg checks) against Python files. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

tools.name: ShellSafetyChecker
tools.description: Run the shell safety checker (missing set -euo pipefail, background job silent failure risk, hardcoded credentials) against shell scripts. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

stderr: [sdlc-integrity-mcp] Server ready. Workspace: /pkg. Tools: AuditCodeIntegrity, JsSafetyChecker, PythonSafetyChecker, ShellSafetyChecker
